# AutoGluon (modified fork)

This is a modified fork of [AutoGluon](https://github.com/autogluon/autogluon)
1.4.1, vendored here because it adds CORAL/CORN ordinal-regression loss
support that upstream AutoGluon does not have. See `CHANGES.md` for exactly
what was changed, and `LICENSE`/`NOTICE` for licensing (Apache-2.0).

Do not install `autogluon`/`autogluon.multimodal` from PyPI for this
project — see the main repository README for install instructions.
